title: Reduction on Parse Failures
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, if the exact CNF parser fails on $x$, then the string-level reduction of $x$ is the serialization of the empty CNF formula.
hypotheses_covered: The exact CNF parser returns failure on $x$
replaced:
If the exact CNF parser fails on a binary string $x$, then the string-level
reduction maps $x$ to the serialization of the (unchanged) empty formula.
